name: Houkago Custom☆Time ~Customize Lovers~
original_name: 放課後かすたむ☆たいむ ～Customize Lovers～
source:
Nodoka is self-conscious about her looks and decided to join the drama club to change herself for the better, but the club is in danger of being closed. There’s only one member: the club leader Nobuhiko. One day while walking to school, she came upon at a small shrine a tiny being the size of a stuffed animal, which called herself the ‘Goddess of Beauty’. In exchange for all the candy that Nodoka gives her, she offers to grant her a wish to make her into the world’s most beautiful woman. However, in order to maintain her appearance, she needs to have a man’s seed in her.

[from[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/07/01/july-2011-eroge-releases/] Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
小早川のどか对自己的相貌缺乏信心，为改变自己而加入戏剧社，社团却正面临废社危机，因为成员只剩社长信彦一人。某天上学途中，她在一座小神社遇见一个布偶大小的生物，对方自称“美之女神”。作为收下所有糖果的回报，女神答应实现のどか的愿望，把她变成世界上最美的女人。然而，要维持这副容貌，她体内必须存有男人的精液。

[译自 [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/07/01/july-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
